{{Top|leg}}
'''Stun mines''' were a class of mine used in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Khlor]] used stun mines to defend his [[Khlor's hideout|hideout]] on an island on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Velusia/Legends|Velusia]].<ref name="CatCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
